title: Alya UI for Minecraft PE ("Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian")
topic: Showcasing an awesome custom anime UI resource pack for Minecraft Bedrock inspired by "Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian" (Roshidere)!
description: Showcasing an awesome custom anime UI resource pack for Minecraft Bedrock inspired by "Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian" (Roshidere)! Take a look at the custom main menu, adorable loading screens featuring Alya, and the newly themed inventory and chat menus. If you are a fan of the anime and want to bring that aesthetic into your Minecraft world, this UI pack showcase is for you.
